simple.meaning: נַחֲלִיאֵל (Nachălîyʼêl) is a Hebrew word meaning “Nachaliël , a place in the Desert.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: נַחֲלִיאֵל (H5160) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Numbers 21:19, with occurrences in Numbers.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to נַחֲלִיאֵל (H5160) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in נַחֲלִיאֵל (H5160) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: נַחֲלִיאֵל (Nachălîyʼêl) / H5160 is traced through Numbers 21:19 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

definitions.short: Nachaliël , a place in the Desert
definitions.full: H5160. Nachaliel נַחֲלִיאֵל proper name, of a location (= valley — or plam — of El); — station of Israel east of Dead Sea Num 21:19 (twice in verse) (JE), possibly (if = valley) one of main tributaries of Arnon, e.g. W. Wâle (see Bliss PEF 1895, 204, 215 ).
